title: SPSS Data Analysis Workshop
description: A fast-paced, hands-on workshop covering practical SPSS techniques for medical and academic researchers, conducted at our Dhaka training center.
outcome: 38 of 42 participants successfully completed independent statistical analyses of their own datasets by the end of the workshop, with 100% certification completion.

title: Manuscript Writing Workshop
shortDescription: Turn your research into a publication-ready manuscript.
description: A focused workshop guiding participants through drafting a complete manuscript from raw data, held in collaboration with a partner medical college.
outcome: 22 draft manuscripts were produced during the workshop, 9 of which were submitted to indexed journals within 3 months.

title: Systematic Review Workshop
description: Practical training on conducting a PRISMA-compliant systematic review from protocol to synthesis.
outcome: 6 systematic review protocols were registered on PROSPERO by participant teams during the workshop period.

title: AI Tools for Research Workshop
shortDescription: Explore AI tools to enhance research efficiency.
description: Hands-on exposure to AI-assisted literature review, writing, and data analysis tools for modern researchers.
outcome: Participant feedback rated the workshop 4.8/5 for practical applicability to ongoing research projects.

title: Research Ethics Workshop
shortDescription: Foundations of ethical clinical and academic research.
description: An essential workshop on research ethics, informed consent, and institutional review board processes.
outcome: All 55 participants completed the institutional ethics certification requirement.
